summary: When Nora tries to open a shared file link as a web page or as media, she is pointed to the file reader instead of being told to ask for the URL.
details: A shared Google Doc, Sheet or Slides link reaches her as a link handle, never the URL; passing that handle to the web or media reader used to answer "ask them for the actual URL".
limitations: A bare six-character code with no link label is still read as not a link.
